newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors to cut output after Aisin fire.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors to cut output after Aisin fire.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Wednesday it will cut its vehicle production by a total of 4,500 units between February 5 and 7 due to a fire at a plant of component supplier Aisin Seiki Co Ltd last weekend.
Mitsubishi produces 5,300 vehicles per day in Japan.

The fire last Saturday at a brake parts maker caused the idling of 22 of a total 30 lines of Toyota Motor Corp's domestic vehicle production lines on Monday and all Toyota's lines on Tuesday except a recreation vehicle line at Daihatsu.

But Toyota said on Tuesday it expected to resume near-normal levels of output at all domestic production lines on Friday. About 90 percent of Aisin's products are shipped to Toyota. Aisin is 22.6 percent by Toyota.

A Mitsubishi spokesman said its O-e plant in Aichi Prefecture will halt production, cancelling Wednesday's night shift and day and night shifts on Thursday. Its Mizushima plant in Okayama Prefecture, western Japan, will cancel daily three-hour overtime work between February 5 and 7.
Mitsubishi has yet to decide its production schedule on and after next Monday.
